in_marathi.name: Ramchander
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ramchander हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Ramchander is derived from two words: 'Ram' meaning God and 'Chander' meaning moon. The name signifies God's abode, which is believed to be the moon in Hindu mythology.

in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God's Abode
